title: The next frontier: Reengineering Indian enterprises for the agentic era
summary: India has a significant opportunity to leverage artificial intelligence for economic growth and productivity. Many enterprises are currently not maximizing the potential of AI across all functions. Leaders are encouraged to rethink their operating models and workflows for better integration of AI. Trust in AI systems is essential as they become embedded in critical operations and decision-making processes.
